plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp endurance-first build for boxing with simple bodyweight sessions that stay beginner-friendly and recoverable. Week 1 establishes baseline top sets on the main strength patterns so later blocks can track progress, and the main training work starts in Week 2. The block keeps some strength, power, and speed support in place, but the priority is aerobic base, repeat-effort capacity, and sport-specific conditioning without adding unnecessary soreness.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build aerobic base, repeat-effort conditioning, and simple full-body strength support with low equipment demands.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress conditioning density and sport-specific work while keeping enough strength and power to support boxing output.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Turn the base into sharper repeatable speed and cleaner sport-specific conditioning without forcing a fight-camp peak.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy sets, then do one hard clean top set stopping only when rep speed slows or body position breaks. Use the hardest variation you can control with full range and a straight body line.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hard top set of 3-10 clean reps on the hardest strict variation you can control. Log the variation and reps to establish your baseline.
